doctrine: Work and commit only in overgo_audiocpp; do not push, write in master, or import master's plan. Honor explicit stops. Do not recursively merge after merge commits or between a group's retained receipts. An urgent demonstrated safety fix may interrupt with affected evidence revalidation. Granite Speech 5.0 470M TurboCTC is the offline reference, native Safetensors Nemotron 3.5 ASR the recurrent/streaming reference, and FireRedVAD the activity reference; the incompatible Q8 GGUF remains rejected. Pin source revision, license, artifact, fixture, transform and independent boundary traces with explicit tolerances. CPU is the numerical authority. Model identities, tensor names, geometry, padding, normalization, ties and composition belong in declarations, never family-specific execution branches. A common operation may have one recipe consumer; add it only for a demonstrated missing behavior with its real consumer and tests. Reuse audiodsp, media.DecodeAudio, safetensors, tokenizer, hostmath/tensor, modelrecipe, capabilityruntime, dataset, evaluation, runrecord, trainingprogram and trainingworkflow. Keep one inference/training forward path and the existing loader, scheduler, optimizer, checkpoint and publication owners. Do not add a graph engine, parallel registry, dataset cache, umbrella audio service or verifier framework. ASR, synthesis, activity, alignment and speaker operations retain separate typed contracts. Consolidation migrates every actual caller and deletes displaced APIs in the same slice; measure state, buffer and API reduction alongside unchanged accepted behavior and explicit refusals. Preserve separate GeneratedAudio, AudioReference and transcript artifacts; synthesis silence does not inherit ASR silence refusal. Preserve the committed CPU ingest-train-evaluate-serve lifecycle, production command/library parity, frozen-final-feature adapter, tied projection ownership, exact stop and resume, pre/post WER and resource evidence, authenticated transcription, cancellation and publication recovery. Resume includes optimizer, random, scheduler and data-stream state. Reuse existing frozen-component training and persist full input/transform/checkpoint lineage. Wider encoder gradients, internal adapters, recurrent-decoder training and CUDA are separate capabilities, not established by that CTC adapter proof. Decode actual samples with complete rejection denominators. Use pinned LibriSpeech clean first; quarantine policy-invalid, silent, near-silent, corrupt, clipped and non-finite ASR inputs. Historical silent AMI materialization stays quarantined until its exact source and transform are established. Historical ingestion failures require replay against the original store and immutable identities, not isolated-store success alone. Reference text never enters prediction. Reuse bounded source-addressed Parquet/Arrow traversal and immutable scoring outputs; do not copy a corpus or cache predictions for timing. Bind each claim to its artifact, source, corpus, protocol, environment and coverage. Performance repetitions execute fresh inference and identify every attempt; separate cold load, warm execution, first partial, finalization and publication. Profile separately from timing. Boundary heap samples are not process peak memory; unknown counters stay absent and unavailable peak/VRAM cannot support promotion. Report failures, denominators and no-gain outcomes. Promotion uses existing quality/resource policy. Static DSP parity is not ASR parity, mel-chunk parity is not raw-waveform or HTTP streaming, and frame advances or VAD segment offsets are not word timestamps. Where the native offline and streaming modes differ, compare each with its own pinned oracle and disclose the difference instead of forcing equality. Preserve AudioStreamCursor progress and checkpoint ownership and AudioStreamSession concurrency/residency ownership; no growing-prefix replay or second scheduler. Then prove live switching/concurrency and reuse those consumers for routing and recovery. Synthesis lifecycle and CPU artifact admission remain independent alternatives before full-encoder expansion. Preserve the remaining voice, speaker, synthesis, generation, gradient, device and audio-conditioned adaptation obligations without claiming them from numerical or contract-only fixtures. Every retained row keeps a non-vacuous acceptance command, exact identity and capability obligation. Planned acceptance names are work to implement, not existing success claims. Require nonempty executed cases and fail on missing artifacts or skipped required subchecks. Read every group member before editing. Each lead implements all member contracts and binds component acceptance in verification_batch before integration; later rows are exact verification receipts. Dependencies target the last required prerequisite receipt. The current gate advances one row per commit: grouping alone proves neither fewer commits nor a speedup. No provisional commits, manual pruning, cross-group source accumulation or weaker acceptance. Use the existing gate, source-isolated execution, transaction-scoped store ownership, terminal package/checkpoint evidence and conservative runtime-file/subprocess-input graph. Reuse only exact independent passing evidence; preserve failed attempts and outstanding obligations across interruption. Measure setup, reused/executed checks and total gate wall. The user also authorizes shared diffusion, training, memory-lifetime and shape-derived execution improvements in this worktree. Keep their acceptance separate from audio capability completion; reuse landed master owners and avoid unrelated platform cleanup or GPU-admission redesign. Audio's batch/recovery proof exercises these owners rather than rebuilding them. Inspect live CPU/RAM/VRAM capacity instead of assuming historical occupancy. Do not terminate other worktrees' processes or clear their reservations. Optimize complete processing sequences before isolated kernels: measure avoidable host/device bytes, layout conversions, synchronization and duplicate live storage, then remove the dominant demonstrated cost through existing resident execution, retained outputs, graph replay and optimizer owners. Verify shared verification_batch and checkpoint memo integration against source-bound chains, invalid declarations, out-of-scope changes, stale evidence and missing final integration. Checkpoints are subordinate obligations, not independent promotion or reduced-policy commits. Reuse master's remaining selection-shadow and cumulative-promotion proof when landed with exact matching contracts. Add only audio-specific counterexamples: external corpus/model bindings, production-training subprocesses, oracle captures and raw-waveform/session/HTTP integration. Preserve conservative scope until independence is proved; historical zero-reuse full gates are cost observations, not evidence that a narrower policy is safe. Attribute verifier preparation, internally repeated training/resource probes, outer deterministic repeat agreement and package execution separately. Review redundant work on the same audio obligations without changing frozen verify-classifier-v1, inserting artificial device/seed markers, or weakening exact-resume, fault-detection and final integration checks. Any new classifier contract must preserve historical replay through the shared owner. Include the early harness-ratchet counterexample recorded in finding evidence:sha256:1336ee039ad2e2ed79edb4b0e988b2dadbad6d9b56003fd2191b8db4587578bc. Exercise change-specific selection on isolated witness diffs for plan-only changes, host audio math, buffer ownership, shared CUDA/ABI, optimizer/checkpoint and serving contracts. Assert inclusion of actual dependent runtime files/subprocesses and exclusion only when independence is established. Report derived selection reasons and executed/reused/inapplicable checks; a broad shared executor change can legitimately require a broad gate. Reuse existing shared admission so CPU checks do not hold an exclusive GPU reservation; correctness may share admitted capacity, while performance remains exclusive. The attempted 27-to-15 row consolidation after merge 476565f7 preserved all 35 verifier commands but was refused by protected-plan membership; keep those identities pending, not completed. Address covered-row retirement through the existing completion/batch owner: explicit member references, exact same-candidate verifier and checkpoint evidence, unchanged prerequisite obligations, atomic Git/store publication and recovery. Reject missing, stale, skipped, changed-verifier, cyclic or unrelated coverage and preserve historical completion lookup; no generic plan-deletion exception.

verification_batch.rationale: Group batch-recovery-proof: implement all member contracts together; checkpoints precede parent integration. Retained member receipts still require normal gates.
verification_batch.reopen_when: Artifact, source, transform, topology, environment, resource policy or completion binding changes; revalidate affected checks and integration.

steps.title: Verify: Measure audio checkpoint reuse, fault detection and final integration through the shared gate
steps.rationale: Group batch-recovery-proof; retained verification receipt for audio-gate-control/integration-control. Measure audio checkpoint/package reuse and fault detection on identical final trees and deliberate source/policy/environment mutations or interrupted publication in disposable fixtures. Failed/skipped/incomplete/stale/wrong-environment evidence must not complete a parent. Compare total wall and executed/reused checks with full-per-change runs; report savings or no gain. Reuse existing controls and keep full commit/promotion checks. Separate queue/admission time, CPU checks, device correctness, exclusive performance, browser acceptance and finalization. Invalidate cached receipts on changed source/artifact/precision/shape/ABI/runtime input, and prove unaffected evidence can be reused without skipping required regression detection.
